title: nixos/hydra: Add zstd and bzip2 to hydra-server's PATH
structural_notes: Diff adds a single `path = [ pkgs.zstd pkgs.bzip2 ];` block (base line ~400) to the existing `systemd.services.hydra-server` definition. No mkOption/mkEnableOption declaration line is touched anywhere in the diff -- verified by directly diffing the fetched base-root/head-root module files, which shows exactly this 5-line addition and nothing else. Per the stated diff-touch rule, only the baseline services.hydra.enable is watched. Test wiring verified per the task's indirection warning: nixos/tests/all-tests.nix has `hydra = runTest ./hydra;` (a directory import), which resolves to nixos/tests/hydra/default.nix (name = "hydra"; imports ./common.nix for baseConfig; nodes.machine imports baseConfig and exercises hydra-init.service, hydra-queue-runner.service, hydra-evaluator.service, hydra-notify.service, hydra-server on port 3000, and runs create-trivial-project.sh + checks build status) -- this IS a real, wired test exercising the hydra-server unit that this PR's PATH change targets. Laid out base-root/head-root with nixos/tests/hydra/{default.nix,common.nix,create-trivial-project.sh} (all three files, unchanged base vs head) alongside the module file.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Both check-base.json and check-head.json report TestConfigUnresolved (not PASS) for services.hydra.enable on target 'hydra' -- excluded from pass_verdicts_needing_review. Raw observation only, no diagnosis attempted: nixos/tests/hydra/default.nix's machine node config is `imports = [ baseConfig ];` where baseConfig comes from `inherit (import ./common.nix) baseConfig;`, an aliased import rather than an inline literal, which is plausibly why the walker can't fully resolve that node's config to a literal enable=true assignment.
